name: Fenton (United States)
description: Dark blue field charged with the city seal, a bandstand in a narrow red ring, between City of Fenton above and Michigan below in white.
history: Fenton is a city in Michigan that lies mostly in Genesee County, with small portions in neighboring Oakland and Livingston Counties.

features.role: city seal with the bandstand, in a narrow red ring, between the words City of Fenton and Michigan in white
